{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check: are there completed orders with converted == 0?
completed_not_converted = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['converted'] == 0)]

# Check: what is the value of 'converted' for refunded orders?
refunded_converted = sales[(sales['status'] == 'refunded') & (sales['converted'] == 1)]

# Print counts
dict(
    completed_not_converted_count=len(completed_not_converted),
    refunded_converted_count=len(refunded_converted),
    completed_count=sales['status'].eq('completed').sum(),
    refunded_count=sales['status'].eq('refunded').sum(),
    converted_1_count=sales['converted'].eq(1).sum(),
    converted_0_count=sales['converted'].eq(0).sum(),
    
    # Check if any 'refunded' have 'converted' == 1
    refunded_converted_value=refunded_converted['converted'].unique(),
    
    # Check if any 'completed' have 'converted' == 0
    completed_not_converted_value=completed_not_converted['converted'].unique(),
    
    # Check if 'converted' == 1 only for 'completed'?
    converted_1_only_completed=(sales[sales['converted']==1]['status'] == 'completed').all(),
    
    # Check if 'status' == 'completed' only when 'converted' == 1?
    status_completed_only_converted_1=(sales[sales['status']=='completed']['converted'] == 1).all(),
)"}
